title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies - Register
subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The dedicated human rights lawyer immediately filed a formal ________ in the high court demanding the unconditional release of the detained journalist.
questions.explain: In a legal and governmental register, a 'writ' is a formal written order issued by a court, typically directing someone to do or refrain from doing a specific act.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The congregation was deeply moved by the powerful ________ delivered by the visiting bishop regarding the virtue of communal forgiveness.
questions.explain: In religious registers (Places of Worship), an instructional or moral discourse delivered by a member of the clergy during a church service is specifically termed a 'sermon'.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The chief epidemiologist gravely warned the task force of a disastrous, full-scale global ________ if basic preventive hygiene measures were recklessly ignored.
questions.explain: In public health and medical registers, a 'pandemic' is an outbreak of a severe disease that occurs over a wide geographic area and affects an exceptionally high proportion of the population.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Following extensive deliberations, the university's academic senate officially approved the fully updated, technologically-driven ________ for the forthcoming academic session.
questions.explain: In the formal educational register, a 'curriculum' specifically denotes the established subjects, courses, and educational content officially comprising a structured program of study.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The apprehended international trafficker formally stood strictly before the stern judge heavily charged with the illicit possession of a heavily restricted Class A ________.
questions.explain: In heavily restricted legal, police, and drug enforcement registers, an illegal, heavily addictive drug profoundly affecting mood or behavior is clinically classified as a 'narcotic'.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies
